rendered:
According to the text, the theoretical capacity of sulfur is 1675 mAh/gS. 

The paper defines 1C as the rate at which the material can deliver its theoretical capacity, so 1C = 1675 mAh/gS. 

At 0.1C, the first-discharge capacity is 91% of the theoretical capacity, which is 91% * 1675 mAh/gS = 1520.25 mAh/gS.
